const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<details><summary>Click to expand</summary><p>Hidden content here.</p></details>", null);
